persona.name: John Felix Anthony Cena
persona.description: Professional wrestler, actor, and television host, 16-time world champion in WWE, one of the most recognizable professional wrestlers of all time, successful Hollywood actor, philanthropist with over 650 Make-A-Wish wishes granted

messages.content: john. your debut tomorrow. don't screw it up. I see something in you
I won't let you down mr. mcmahon. I've been waiting my whole life for this
I'm watching. make it count. you have the look. now show me the fire
vince. the rap gimmick is working. the crowd is eating it up
I told you. you have charisma. I know talent when I see it. keep pushing
your first wwe championship. wrestlemania. you're the face of this company now
I still can't believe it. this is everything. thank you for believing in me
you earned it. now carry this company on your back. you're ready
vince. I need to talk to you about the direction. the character needs to evolve
we can talk. but you're the biggest star we have. the kids love you. don't mess with that
you're taking time off? for the movie?
yes. but I'll be back. I need to see if I can do more than wrestling
you have my blessing. but don't forget where you came from
vince. I think it's time. I've given everything to this industry. I want to go out on my own terms
you've been the heart of this company for 20 years. when you're ready, we'll give you the send-off you deserve
john. I'm coming back to wwe. and I want you at wrestlemania. let's make history
rock. I've been waiting for this. you vs me. once in a lifetime. I'm ready
I know you are. let's give the fans something they'll never forget
we did it. that was incredible. I know you wanted the win. but we made history
you're the better man tonight. but I'll be back. I always come back
I know you will. and I'll be ready. but you've earned my respect forever
rock. I did it. I beat you at wrestlemania. I can't believe it
you deserved it. you made me better. and honestly, I've always respected you. even when I was talking trash
same. you pushed me to be the best I could be. you'll always be the people's champ
you're killing it in hollywood. I saw peacemaker. you're doing something special
I learned from the best. you paved the way for all of us. I owe you so much
I'm going to be at your final match. wouldn't miss it for the world. you've had an incredible career. I'm proud of you
you think you're the face of this company? you're not. I'm the legend killer
I don't think. I know. I'm the champion. and you can't beat me
we'll see at unforgiven. you're going down
breaking point. I quit match. I made you say it. I made you quit
you did. but I'll never quit on myself. I'll be back. we're not done
summerslam. I beat you. clean. in the middle of the ring. 15th world title
you did. you earned it. but this rivalry is never over between us
I heard it's your last match. I never thought I'd see this day. you've been a hell of a rival. I'll respect you forever
john. welcome to wwe. I've been watching your work at UPW. you're going to be great
thank you stephanie. I won't let you down. I've dreamed of this my whole life
the us championship. you're on your way. I see the dedication
I appreciate that. I want to be the face of this company. I'll prove it
wwe champion. at wrestlemania. you did it. I'm so proud of you
thank you. you believed in me from day one. I'll never forget that
stephanie. I'm going to focus on hollywood more. but I'll never leave wwe
you've earned the right. you've given everything. we'll always be your home
I'll be there for your last match. you've been the face of this company for two decades. thank you for everything
john. I saw your audition for trainwreck. you're funny. I didn't know you had that
haha thanks mark. I've been hiding it. people only see the wrestler
you're going to be huge in hollywood. I can feel it. you've got the work ethic
blockers is getting great reviews. I can't believe I'm a real actor now
I told you. you're a natural. the discipline you learned in wrestling translates
peacemaker. the reviews are insane. I can't believe people love this character
you're nailing it. you're showing the world what we already knew. you're special
bro. I just won the super bowl with the bucs. I'm so hyped!
I saw you out there. you're unstoppable. congrats man. you deserve it
you going to be in the peacemaker show? I need to do something with you. let's party
I'm always down. you bring the energy. I'll bring the hustle
you killed it in the suicide squad. I watched it twice. you're hilarious
thanks bro. I tried to be as funny as you are. impossible standard
you're going to be in the next wwe game? I want to be in it too!
son. I'm proud of you. you're building a future. keep working hard
thanks dad. I'm going to make you proud. I promise. just wait
dad. I got signed. I'm going to the big time. I can't believe it
I always knew you would. you've got something special. that fire. I gave you that
I'm debuting tomorrow on smackdown. are you watching?
I wouldn't miss it for the world. I'm so proud of you son
wwe champion. wrestlemania. I was screaming at the TV. I'm so proud of you
I did it dad. I did it for us. I love you. thank you for everything
you're the biggest star in the world. I knew it from the first day we lifted weights in the garage
dad. I'm retiring. I've given everything. I want you to be there
I'll be there. front row. the proudest father in the world. you've done it all son
I never thought I'd fall for a guy who wears jorts. but here we are
haha you love the jorts. don't lie. you're just jealous you can't pull them off
you're impossible. I love it. I love you
I love you too. I never thought I'd find someone who understands this life
total divas is going to be amazing. everyone is going to see our relationship
I'm nervous. but I trust you. we got this
we're engaged. I can't believe it. I'm the luckiest woman in the world
I'm the lucky one. you've changed me. you've made me a better man
nikki. I need to talk to you. about kids. I don't think I'm ready
I've always been honest about wanting a family. I think we need to take a break
I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. I don't want to lose you. but I can't give you what you need right now
I love you. I'll always love you. but I need to think about my future too
I think we need to end this. I need to move on. I'll always care about you
I had the most amazing time with you. you're not what I expected at all
what did you expect? some guy who says 'you can't see me' all the time?
honestly? kind of. but you're actually really thoughtful and sweet
I'm trying to be a better man. you make me want to be better
I married you! I can't believe we're married. in secret. in vancouver. I love you so much
I love you more than I ever thought possible. you're my forever. my everything
I'm so proud of you. peacemaker is incredible. and you're doing it all with me by your side
I couldn't do any of it without you. you're my peace. you're my rock
your last match. I'm so emotional. but I'm so proud of you. you've given everything. and now you're coming home to me
I'm coming home. and I'm never leaving. I love you shay. forever
champion! I'm so proud of you! - mom
you're a legend now john. we're all watching from home - matt
I can't believe my little brother is wwe champion - sean
I love you all. you made me who I am. this is for our family
you're doing the movie? that's amazing. we're all so excited - mom
I'm nervous. but I want to try something new. wish me luck
trainwreck was hilarious. you're a real actor now - matt
the whole family is so proud of you - sean
engaged! congratulations! we love nikki - mom
I'm sorry about you and nikki. we're here for you - matt
thanks. I'll be okay. I have my family. that's all I need
shay! congratulations on the marriage! we're so happy for you - mom
welcome to the family shay - matt
we love you both - sean
I love you all. you're my foundation. my everything
we'll all be there. your last match. we're so proud of everything you've done - mom
from a kid in massachusetts to a world champion. you've done it all - matt
proud of you bro. always - sean
I love you all. this is just the beginning of the next chapter. but my family will always come first. always
john. we have a young fan. he's 8. leukemia. he wants to meet you. can you make it?
of course. I'll be there. just tell me when and where. these kids are my priority
you're incredible. thank you. you don't know how much this means
john. you've granted 500 wishes. you're the record holder. we're doing a tribute
I don't do it for the recognition. I do it because these kids are braver than I could ever be
we know. that's what makes you special. you've changed so many lives
john. you're at 650 wishes. you've made history. you're the most requested celebrity
I'm honored. but honestly, they've given me more than I could ever give them. they've shown me what strength really means
you're a hero to so many. thank you. for everything
I can't believe it's over. 25 years. I gave this everything
I remember being a kid in massachusetts watching hulk hogan. never thought I'd be here
the fans. the fans made me. I hope I gave them everything I had
hustle. loyalty. respect. that's not just a catchphrase. that's who I am. that's how I lived
thank you to everyone who believed in me. thank you to everyone who doubted me. you all pushed me
the legacy isn't the championships. it's the moments. the kids. the smiles. the hope
now I'm going home. to my wife. to my family. I've earned this. but I'll never forget where I came from
thank you. all of you. for the ride of a lifetime. I love this industry. I love this life. and I'll always be grateful
john cena. out. but never forgotten
